newsitem.title: THAILAND: Submicron says Thai IPO delayed.
newsitem.headline: Submicron says Thai IPO delayed.

text.p: Submicron, which aims to be Thailand's first wafer fabrication facility, said on Friday that its initial public offering had been delayed due to the bearish state of the Thai stock market.
"At the moment we have postponed it. A tentative timetable is being worked out by lead underwriter Dhana Siam which is driving the show," said Submicron Treasurer Krisda Leeaphorn.
He told Reuters a decline in the Thai stockmarket, which is hovering around three year lows, had caused the delay.

Construction and installation at its wafer fabrication facility at eastern Cherngsao, which will produce flash and ASIC memory semiconductor wafers, will procede as planned despite the postponement since project financing was in place, he said.
It is due to be ready in June.
"We've had a meeting with the banks and they are fully supportive," Krisda said.
Investment banking officials at co-underwriters Thaimex Finance and Securities said the underwriters were due to meet next week to revise the listing schedule.
